|-|Trivia=
*The teasers are text taken from the {{w|Wikipedia}} article on {{w|bank robbery}}.
*Like the difficulty achievements released on Locke and Load Day 3, most of the names of the achievements released in this update are player suggestions from the [https://steamcommunity.com/app/218620/discussions/10/154645497345310070/ Do you know what would be a great name for an achievement?] thread.
*'''Just an' Old Country Doctor''' may be reference to the song "Just An Old Country Preacher" by {{w|Larry Sparks}}.
*'''Home is Where the Battle is''' refers to the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z066RWjHqIc song of the same name] composed by {{w|Dasha Charusha}}, composed for the ''{{w|Hardcore Henry}}'' soundtrack.
*'''{{w|Megalodon}}''' is a species of {{w|shark}}. This was formerly the name of the achievement for completing [[the Yacht Heist]] on One Down.
*'''Hey, It Looks Like You are Robbing a Bank''' is a reference to the {{w|Office Assistant|Microsoft Office Assistant}}, better known as "Clippit/Clippy" by its paperclip avatar, infamous for being annoying. Some players have compared [[Bain]] nagging the players about the thermal drill to Clippy.
*'''Make Like a Tree...and Get Out of Here''' is one of {{w|Biff Tannen}}'s taglines in the {{w|Back to the Future (franchise)|''Back to the Future'' franchise}}.
*'''Bad Code''', '''Bank on Me''', and '''Lots of Pigs, But no Pigs''' are [[achievements]] from ''[[PAYDAY: The Heist]]''.
*'''Some People Want to See the World Burn''' refers to a [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/some-men-just-want-to-watch-the-world-burn memetic quote] from ''{{w|The Dark Knight}}''.
*'''Four Heister Discount''' is a reference to "five finger discount", another name for {{w|shoplifting}}. It may also be a reference to ''{{w|The Simpsons}}'', where a character calls shoplifting a "four finger discount", being a joke on the saying and most ''Simpsons'' characters only having four fingers on each hand.
*'''Hoxit''' is a pun on [[Hoxton]] and {{w|Brexit}}.
*'''The_heister27''' refers to a [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/thelegend27 meme] originating from an ad for ''{{w|Game of War: Fire Age}}''.
*'''Makin' My Way Downtown''' is a reference to {{w|Vanessa Carlton}}'s debut single "{{w|A Thousand Miles}}".
*'''Dead, Wrapped in Plastic''' refers to a quote from the {{w|Pilot (Twin Peaks)|pilot episode}} of ''{{w|Twin Peaks}}''.
*'''Fast Track to Hell''' may be a reference to punk rock musician [https://www.last.fm/music/Neon+Leon/+wiki Neon Leon's] autobiography of the same name.
*'''If It Bleeds, Kill It''' is likely a reference to a quote from ''{{w|Predator (film)|Predator}}''.
*'''Bain's Lament''' refers to "Baldwin's Lament", an entity that [[Bain]] was searching for.
*'''All You Need is A Knife''' may be a reference to the song "{{w|Ironic (song)|Ironic}}" by {{w|Alanis Morissette}}, which contains the verse ''"It's like ten thousand spoons when all you need is a knife"''.
